title: New Orleans parade bands and leaving in 1911
summary: He worked parade jobs with the Eagle, Security, Excelsior and Superior bands and left New Orleans in 1911, earlier than the books say.

blocks.x: All right. We're going all the way around, which I think is a good way to do it. So, we've -- we're covering a lot of ground and we're making a lot of corrections. Did you work in the -- in New Orleans, before you leave, did you do parade work with the Eagle Band?
Yeah. And the Superior Band, too.
Right. And most of the books say that Ed Garland leaves New Orleans in 1914. Didn't we say it was -- what was it? Didn't you leave in '11? 1911.

Okay. So what I wondered about was most of the books, Toetie, say that many of the New Orleans musicians leave in 1917, when Storyville, or the District, as it was called, closed. But you leave in '11. Was there more work in Chicago for you? Or, what?
